# Trident Software GmbH

> Swiss AI-native software engineering company. Founded 2009 in Sion, Valais, Switzerland. Senior engineers only, fixed budgets, compliance included.

## About

Trident Software builds custom software, AI systems, and embedded solutions for European SMEs. 26 senior engineers across Switzerland, Ukraine, and Israel. 27+ projects delivered since 2009.

## Services

- AI Services — LLM integration, RAG pipelines, AI agents, computer vision
- Custom Software Engineering — full-stack, web, mobile
- Embedded & IoT — firmware, industrial automation
- CTO as a Service — fractional CTO, technical leadership
- Cloud Consulting — AWS, GCP, Azure architecture
- DevOps & SRE — CI/CD, infrastructure, monitoring
- UI/UX Design — product design, design systems
- Team Extension — senior engineers on demand

## Industries

Healthcare, Automotive, Logistics, Fintech, Retail & E-commerce, SaaS, Manufacturing, PropTech, Energy, Insurance, Hospitality, LegalTech, Fashion & Lifestyle, Agriculture, Public Sector, Media & Entertainment.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2009, Sion, Valais, Switzerland
- Team: 26 senior engineers (no juniors on client projects)
- Offices: Sion (HQ), Kyiv, Tel Aviv
- Languages: English, German, French, Italian
- Compliance: ISO 27000, nFADP, Swiss data residency
- AI since: 2021 (18 months before ChatGPT)
- Repeat clients: 73% of revenue
